We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your should-cost estimate and your proposal for a 24-month agreement.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €432.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

In response to your preference for a longer commitment, we can accept the 24-month term with 30 days net payment, allowing us to offer a revised price of EUR 429.36 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €429.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer balances your request for planning stability with the documented cost pressures in our supply chain. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
